Status.note: The EIA-860M table for August 2026 lists generator 5 at Marion, plant 976, as operating, 75 MW, natural gas combustion turbine, operating since May 2003. The EIA annual generation survey for 2024, which I read from a file on disk, shows the plant's gas turbines generated about 113,500 megawatt-hours that year, so they ran. Both come from the Energy Information Administration, so this is one source. An Illinois Country Living article from 2020 also says the cooperative still has two natural gas units after Unit 4 closed. No source says these units are mothballed. This is a status change from mothballed, so it needs a second publisher.
